DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE source_channel <> 'web') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot remove teacher dialog source channel while non-web jobs exist';
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job
    DROP CONSTRAINT chk_teacher_dialog_job_source_channel,
    DROP COLUMN source_channel;
